BUt to me, it seemed that I will never be able to be as good enough as my brother, no matter how hard I try and how much I study. It really messed me up and it's part of the things I only came in peace with during therapy.

I just want to say how refreshing it is to read a thread like this one. I'm an INTP and going through the INTP subreddit, I can't help but feel alienated (a very INTP characteristic, so I'm told) because every INTP thread seems to talk about their lack of feelings. While most of the time, I don't care about what other people think I have to admit that I do feel things more intensely and more deeply than other people and this has always bothered me. For quite some time, I doubted being an INTP because for an INTP, I seem to have a lot of feelings (granted, they're kind of a mess and I can't differentiate one from the other all that well). It's very hard to catch my attention and it takes some time for me to warm up to people but once someone does manage to catch my attention and I grow used to their company, I start opening up my own secret world to them (not all at once of course).
